title: decode_msgid_from_url missing %20 decode makes inbound In-Reply-To incorrect
description: Trigger: inbound Create{Note} activity whose object.inReplyTo is a stoa article URL where the original message-id contained a space (percent-encoded as %20 by percent_encode_msgid). decode_msgid_from_url decodes %3C/%3E/%40/%2F but not %20. The reconstructed In-Reply-To header retains literal %20 instead of a space, corrupting the threading chain. Standard message-IDs do not contain spaces (RFC 5322 forbids them in the local-part), so this is low-probability but the encode/decode pair is still incorrect by inspection.
